data.one_liner: Indian localization, fintech toolkit, currency formatters, PIN lookup, and ID validators for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides enterprise-grade Indian localization and fintech utilities including currency formatting, strict compliance ID validation (Aadhaar, PAN, UPI, IFSC, LEI, ABHA, CKYC), timing-safe security tools, and precise Paise-based money calculations.
use_when: Building fintech or banking applications targeting the Indian market.
Validating Indian statutory identity documents and bank account numbers.
Needing precise floating-point-free monetary calculations in Paise.
avoid_when: Developing applications focused entirely outside of Indian financial and regulatory frameworks.
Needing a general-purpose non-Indian internationalization library.
strengths: Comprehensive coverage of RBI, NPCI, and UIDAI compliance requirements.
Advanced security features like timing-safe equality and PII redacting.
weaknesses: Highly specific to Indian financial regulations and localization norms.
Limited utility for global or non-Indian payment flows.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import the package.
